annotations.title: Move pages to a new spread

description: Take a run of pages (1–24 page_ids, not page_id) out of their spread (Druckbogen) into a new spread directly behind it – the page order stays, only the spread division changes. Repairs a three-page spread after add_page. The pages must lie on the same spread, be direct neighbours and must not be all pages of that spread. Shuffle is suspended for the call and the new spread is created with shuffle off. Returns moved_page_ids, names, new_spread_index, new_spread_page_count, source_spread_index, source_spread_page_count, spread_count and page_count. Read list_pages and get_layout_grid again afterwards.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

page_ids.description: Pages to move into the new spread – same spread, direct neighbours, not all of them.

name: move_pages_to_new_spread
title: Move pages to a new spread
